purpose: Ronda 24 de uso real (r23 t2-c03#2 «ya cierra configuracion que me esta laggeando el valorant» → «¿Te gustaría que cierre la configuración ahora mismo?», t4-c03 t4 «ya cierra discord» → «¿Quieres que cierre Discord ahora mismo?»): a yes/no question that only says the order back asks for nothing (semantic.dialogue.question_only_says_the_order_back). yes_no_openers: the words such a question opens with, folded and without accents. filler: the words it may add without asking for anything (articles, «ahora mismo», «por favor»). alternatives: a word that offers a choice («¿cierro Chrome o Word?») makes it a real question. The operation is done only when its catalog risk lets the kernel bind any confirmation to the invocation (__main__._operations_the_question_only_says_back). pointers (revisión 1: «¿Quieres que lo cierre?» after «ciérralo», «Do you want me to close it?» after «close it»): a question that points instead of naming asks about a referent still unresolved, so it is a real question; «la», «los», «las» stay filler as articles and the pointer guard of __main__ (M19/M118) judges the action. The reason openers (revisión 2: «ya cierra configuracion que me esta laggeando el valorant»; since r31 the one list of semantic.lexicon.REASON_OPENERS, shared with the readers of a window order, a title and a placing): what may follow the words the question says back when the readers cannot read the whole request — a clause that only tells why («que me…», «porque…», «because…»); «que» alone also opens which one («la ventana que dice error») and is no reason. Verbs said back in another mood are compared as order heads (semantic.dialogue._order_heads), never by prefix. takes_back (revisión 3: «cierra discord que me esta laggeando o mejor no», «close discord because it lags but not yet»): after the words said back (and the reason opener, whose own «no» is part of the reason: «que ya no lo uso»), an adversative or disjunctive connective takes the order back or offers another choice; with the refusals and the interjections of data/correction_words.v1.json and its cease_orders (semantic.dialogue.takes_the_order_back) the order is no longer whole, and the question stays. English negative contractions are listed without their apostrophe.
